chapter: City bands, Johnny Dodds and the bag factory
title: Pay for college dances, living alone, and no clubs or parades
summary: He charged $35 for white college dances, took home leftover beer, talks about living alone and a girlfriend, and says he belonged to no clubs or brass band parades.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope
